greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto, oo ha idinku xoojiso ducadan aan maanta u wada joogno.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Kiristoow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Codkoodu wuxuu ka dhex dhawaaqaa dhulka oo dhan.
homily:
Waxaan rabaa inaad maanta maskaxda ku haysataan hal shay oo aad u fudud, laakiin aad u qoto dheer: waa aasaaska guriga. Bal ka fikir gurigaaga. Waxaa jira gidaarro, waxaa jira saqaf, waxaa jira albaabbo aad maalin kasta furto oo aad xirto. Laakiin waxa guriga ka dhigaya meel la deggan yahay ma aha oo kaliya qoryaha iyo dhagaxyada; waa dadka gudaha ku jira, waa jacaylka isku haya, iyo aasaaska uu gurigaas ku dul taagan yahay. Qorniinka maanta, Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaanan mar dambe ahayn shisheeye, ee aan nahay xubno ka tirsan reerka Ilaah. Waxaan nahay dhagaxyo nool oo lagu dhisayo macbud quduus ah, iyadoo Ciise Masiix uu yahay 'dhagaxa xagasha', kan ugu muhiimsan ee qaab-dhismeedka oo dhan isku haya.

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil aad u jeclaa dhismaha iyo abuurista. Waxaan ognahay sida uu ugu raaxaysan jiray koodhka uu ku qorayay GitHub, sida uu u dhisayay nidaamyada tiknoolajiyadda, iyo sida uu maskaxdiisa ugu sawiran jiray 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas diyaaradeed ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray. Ben wuxuu ahaa naqshadeeye. Wuxuu jeclaa inuu wax dhiso, inuu wax hagaajiyo, iyo inuu adduunka ka eego meel sare. Laakiin dhismihiisa ugu weyn ma ahayn mid ka samaysan bir ama koodh kombuyuutar; dhismihiisa ugu weyn wuxuu ahaa jacaylka uu u hayay qoyskiisa. Xusuusnow markii uu dhowr sano ka hor, isagoo da' yar, uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa aasaas adag oo jacayl ah. Taasi waa dhagaxa xagasha ee nolosha Ben.

Laakiin, aan runta ka hadalno. Waxaan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in marka aad guriga dhexdiisa socotaan, aad dareemaysaan inuu jiro meel bannaan oo aan marnaba la buuxin karin. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad eegtaan kuraasta, ama aad maqashaan dhawaaqa hawada oo guriga dhex maraya, oo aad dareemaysaan in dunidu ay istaagtay. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan si jilicsan idiin xusuusiyo: xanuunkan iyo dhibaatadan midkoodna ma aha khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa mid aan xad lahayn. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ciise uu buurta koray si uu u soo tukado. Habeen dhan ayuu la hadlayay Aabbaha. Markuu waagu baryay, wuxuu doortay xertiisa. Wuxuu u yeeray Siimon iyo Yuudas iyo kuwa kaleba. Ciise wuxuu dhisayay aasaaska kaniisadda. Wuxuu doortay dad aan dhammaystirnayn, dad qalad samayn kara, laakiin wuxuu iyaga ka dhigay tiirarka Boqortooyada. Ben, isaguna, wuxuu ahaa tiir. In kasta oo noloshiisu ay gaabanayd, wuxuu ahaa mid dhisayay quluubta dadka ku xeeran. Wuxuu ahaa wiil naxariis badan, wiil qosolkiisu uu ahaa mid dadka kale kor u qaada. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jeclaa inuu adduunka arko, oo hadda, wuxuu ka arkaa adduunka meel ka sii sareysa. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo ah meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, oo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida dhagaxa xagasha ee isku haya dhismaha, jacaylka uu Ben kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in guriga Ilaah uu ballaaran yahay, oo Ben uu halkaas idiin sugayo. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana ku jeclaan lahaa inaan naftayda kula midoobo. Maaddaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Eucharist-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan ku soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda gebi ahaanba kuu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhowro, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa, oo ay nabad ku helaan xaggiisa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska wada, inuu Rabbigu qalbigooda u naxariisto, oo uu siiyo rajo iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sidaas darteed, idinku ma tihidin mar dambe shisheeye iyo sooryo, laakiin waxaad tihiin muwaadiniin la jira quduusiinta iyo xubno ka tirsan reerka Ilaah, oo lagu dhisay aasaaskii rasuulladii iyo nebiyadii, iyadoo Ciise Masiix laftiisu uu yahay dhagaxa xagasha. Isaga ayay dhismuhu oo dhan isku hayaan, oo uu ku koraa macbud quduus ah oo Rabbiga u gaar ah; isaga ayaana idinkana la idinku dhisayaa si aad u noqotaan meel uu Ilaah ku deggan yahay Ruuxa.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Cirku wuxuu ku dhawaaqaa ammaanta Ilaah, oo samaduna waxay muujisaa shuqulkii gacmihiisa. Maalinba maalinta kale ayay hadalka u gudbisaa, oo habeenba habeenka kale ayay aqoonta u sheegtaa. Ma jiro hadal ama hadal ka dhex dhawaaqaya oo codkoodu aanu maqlin; codkoodu wuxuu ka dhex dhawaaqaa dhulka oo dhan, oo hadalkooduna wuxuu gaadhaa dhammaadka dunida.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Maalmahaas Ciise wuxuu u kacay buurta inuu tukado, wuxuuna habeenkii oo dhan ku qaatay tukashada Ilaah. Markii waagu baryay, wuxuu u yeeray xertiisa, wuxuuna ka dhex doortay laba iyo toban, kuwaas oo uu u bixiyay rasuullo: Siimon, oo uu u bixiyay Butros, iyo walaalkiis Andarawas, Yacquub, Yooxanaa, Filibos, Bartolomayos, Matayos, Toomas, Yacquub ina Alfi'os, Siimon oo la odhan jiray Selootes, Yuudas ina Yacquub, iyo Yuudas Iskariyod, kii noqday khaa'inka.

day: Feast of Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
